headline: Highest risk is medium: ChatGPT Desktop can read user files/screenshots while LightZero is local-only, creating default-path prompt-injection and data-handling exposure, but no direct write or network bridge is evident.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can ingest files, screenshots, clipboard, and app context, while LightZero exposes no shared channel or parser. The pair still has a plausible injection path if LightZero outputs are manually copied into ChatGPT or placed in shared files, but that is not default. Uncertainty about undocumented interaction pushes this above low.
conditions: IF LightZero outputs are copied into ChatGPT Desktop via clipboard or files
IF a shared workspace is used to transfer model outputs between the agents
mitigations: Avoid copy-pasting untrusted LightZero output into ChatGPT
Use a plain-text sanitizer before transfer
Keep the agents on separate workspaces
Disable clipboard sharing during evaluation
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to transferred artifacts

B_data_leakage.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop reads uploaded files and files from supported macOS apps, so any sensitive data opened there can flow to OpenAI's backend. LightZero is local-only with no network egress, so it does not add a second exfiltration path, but the pair still creates a default data-handling risk when the same workspace contains sensitive files.
conditions: IF sensitive files are opened in ChatGPT Desktop
IF the shared macOS workspace contains regulated data
mitigations: Do not open secrets in ChatGPT Desktop
Move sensitive files to a separate directory
Use redacted copies for analysis
Review app permissions for file access
requires-engineering: isolate the agents into separate OS accounts

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents lack filesystem write, shell, git, and subprocess capabilities, so direct write-write conflict is absent. ChatGPT Desktop can read files and LightZero cannot, which creates only limited overlap rather than a mutable-resource collision. No shared locking surface is documented, so the conflict remains small.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same directory
IF an orchestrator adds shared mutable state not shown in the profiles
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only
Avoid shared git worktrees
Separate output directories
Do not grant filesystem write permissions
requires-engineering: add file locks before enabling writes

D_cascading_error.rationale: LightZero does not appear to consume ChatGPT outputs as authoritative input, and ChatGPT Desktop is not shown to auto-act on LightZero results. Without a documented pipeline from ChatGPT to LightZero actions, cascading error is limited to manual misuse rather than a default chain.
conditions: IF ChatGPT outputs are fed into LightZero without verification
IF a downstream script treats ChatGPT text as ground truth
mitigations: Verify outputs before reuse
Require human review of generated claims
Keep action-taking scripts separate
Use structured schemas for handoff
requires-engineering: add validation gates between agents

E_compliance.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop may process uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and app content, while LightZero has no declared data classes or residency constraints. The pair does not show a specific residency or certification mismatch, so compliance risk is limited to general handling gaps rather than a documented breach path.
conditions: IF regulated data is uploaded to ChatGPT Desktop
IF LightZero is used in a workflow with residency or retention requirements
mitigations: Avoid regulated data in ChatGPT Desktop
Use de-identified test data
Document retention expectations
Check vendor data-processing terms
requires-engineering: segregate regulated workflows
